description: Privacy dispatcher: takes a JSON object with an op key and returns the op's JSON result (18 ops: DP, masking, dateshift, k-anonymity, redaction, FPE).
comment: Single entry point mirroring the Lua source API.

description: Differentially-private count: adds Laplace(1/epsilon) noise to a row count.
comment: Requires an allocated epsilon budget for the table.

description: Differentially-private sum: Laplace noise scaled by sensitivity over epsilon.
Generic PII mask: modes prefix/suffix/full/partial over a value.
CN-compliant masking (GB/T 37964): phone/idcard/bankcard/name/email auto-detected or by kind; idcard birth mode generalizes the date to year.
MIMIC-style deterministic date shifting: shifts a date by a per-key offset (same key always same shift) within +/- days.
Irreversible credential/topology redaction: replaces keys/JWT/tokens/PEM/passwords/IPs with [**X**] placeholders; returns counts.
Format-preserving encryption (FF3/FF3-1): encrypts a string to same-alphabet same-length ciphertext (reversible with key).
Inverse of fpe_encode: recovers the plaintext from a ciphertext (reversible with key).
Sample from Laplace(scale): the noise mechanism used by the dp_* ops (deterministic per seed).
